Both, you'd want to do random samples from every batch Have independent third parties auditing them seems a lot more expensive than running a full node :p but yeah i agree with you Huh? Running a full node is unrelated to key management fine. we were talking of auditability of software v hardware ig . software is easier to audit and easier to verify somebody else's claims hardware wallet even if somebody does independent testing you cant verify their claims - either way When I was getting at with that is if you want to steal someone's funds through like that you're not going to be doing it by attacking every blockchain node
